comment:
* Information about a country's time zones.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: defaultTimeZoneBoosted
variables.comment:
* {@code true} indicates the default time zone for a country is a good choice if a time zone
     * cannot be determined by other means.

variables.name: defaultTimeZone
variables.comment:
* Memoized frozen ICU TimeZone object for the default. Can be {@link TimeZone#UNKNOWN_ZONE} if
     * the {@link #defaultTimeZoneId} is missing or unrecognized.

methods.name: public static CountryTimeZones createValidated(String countryIso, String defaultTimeZoneId, boolean defaultTimeZoneBoosted, boolean everUsesUtc, List<TimeZoneMapping> timeZoneMappings, String debugInfo)
methods.comment: * Creates a {@link CountryTimeZones} object containing only known time zone IDs.

methods.name: public String getCountryIso()
methods.comment: * Returns the ISO code for the country.

methods.name: public boolean matchesCountryCode(String countryIso)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the ISO code for the country is a case-insensitive match for the one
     * supplied.

methods.name: public String getDefaultTimeZoneId()
methods.comment:
* Returns the default time zone ID for the country. Can return {@code null} in cases when no
     * data is available or the time zone ID provided to
     * {@link #createValidated(String, String, boolean, boolean, List, String)} was not recognized.

methods.name: public synchronized TimeZone getDefaultTimeZone()
methods.comment:
* Returns the default time zone for the country. Can return {@code null} in cases when no data
     * is available or the time zone ID provided to
     * {@link #createValidated(String, String, boolean, boolean, List, String)} was not recognized.

methods.name: public boolean isDefaultTimeZoneBoosted()
methods.comment: * Qualifier for a country's default time zone. {@code true} indicates that the country's * default time zone would be a good choice generally when there's no UTC offset * information available. This will only be {@code true} in countries with multiple zones where * a large majority of the population is covered by only one of them.

methods.name: public List<TimeZoneMapping> getTimeZoneMappings()
methods.comment:
* Returns an immutable, ordered list of time zone mappings for the country in an undefined but
     * "priority" order. The list can be empty if there were no zones configured or the configured
     * zone IDs were not recognized.

methods.name: public boolean hasUtcZone(long whenMillis)
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if the country has at least one time zone that uses UTC at the given * time. This is an efficient check when trying to validate received UTC offset information. * For example, there are situations when a detected zero UTC offset cannot be distinguished * from "no information available" or a corrupted signal. This method is useful because checking * offset information for large countries is relatively expensive but it is generally only the * countries close to the prime meridian that use UTC at any time of the year. * * @param whenMillis the time the offset information is for in milliseconds since the beginning * of the Unix epoch

methods.name: public OffsetResult lookupByOffsetWithBias(long whenMillis, TimeZone bias, int totalOffsetMillis, boolean isDst)
methods.comment:
* Returns a time zone for the country, if there is one, that matches the supplied properties.
     * If there are multiple matches and the {@code bias} is one of them then it is returned,
     * otherwise an arbitrary match is returned based on the {@link
     * #getEffectiveTimeZoneMappingsAt(long)} ordering.
     *
     * @param whenMillis the Unix epoch time to match against
     * @param bias the time zone to prefer, can be {@code null} to indicate there is no preference
     * @param totalOffsetMillis the offset from UTC at {@code whenMillis}
     * @param isDst the Daylight Savings Time state at {@code whenMillis}. {@code true} means DST,
     *     {@code false} means not DST
     * @return an {@link OffsetResult} with information about a matching zone, or {@code null} if
     *     there is no match

methods.name: public OffsetResult lookupByOffsetWithBias(long whenMillis, TimeZone bias, int totalOffsetMillis)
methods.comment:
* Returns a time zone for the country, if there is one, that matches the supplied properties.
     * If there are multiple matches and the {@code bias} is one of them then it is returned,
     * otherwise an arbitrary match is returned based on the {@link
     * #getEffectiveTimeZoneMappingsAt(long)} ordering.
     *
     * @param whenMillis the Unix epoch time to match against
     * @param bias the time zone to prefer, can be {@code null} to indicate there is no preference
     * @param totalOffsetMillis the offset from UTC at {@code whenMillis}
     * @return an {@link OffsetResult} with information about a matching zone, or {@code null} if
     *     there is no match

methods.name: public List<TimeZoneMapping> getEffectiveTimeZoneMappingsAt(long whenMillis)
methods.comment:
* Returns an immutable, ordered list of time zone mappings for the country in an undefined but
     * "priority" order, filtered so that only "effective" time zone IDs are returned. An
     * "effective" time zone is one that differs from another time zone used in the country after
     * {@code whenMillis}. The list can be empty if there were no zones configured or the configured
     * zone IDs were not recognized.

methods.name: private OffsetResult lookupByOffsetWithBiasInternal(long whenMillis, TimeZone bias, int totalOffsetMillis, Boolean isDst)
methods.comment:
* Returns a time zone for the country, if there is one, that matches the supplied properties.
     * If there are multiple matches and the {@code bias} is one of them then it is returned,
     * otherwise an arbitrary match is returned based on the {@link
     * #getEffectiveTimeZoneMappingsAt(long)} ordering.
     *
     * @param whenMillis the Unix epoch time to match against
     * @param bias the time zone to prefer, can be {@code null}
     * @param totalOffsetMillis the offset from UTC at {@code whenMillis}
     * @param isDst the Daylight Savings Time state at {@code whenMillis}. {@code true} means DST,
     *     {@code false} means not DST, {@code null} means unknown

methods.name: private static boolean offsetMatchesAtTime(long whenMillis, TimeZone timeZone, int totalOffsetMillis, Boolean isDst)
methods.comment:
* Returns {@code true} if the specified {@code totalOffset} and {@code isDst} would be valid in
     * the {@code timeZone} at time {@code whenMillis}.
     * {@code totalOffetMillis} is always matched.
     * If {@code isDst} is {@code null}, this means the DST state is unknown.
     * If {@code isDst} is {@code false}, this means the zone must not be in DST.
     * If {@code isDst} is {@code true}, this means the zone must be in DST.
